Reviewed W05 head `43f7cf6e8681fa617b5d6d3529d94d537ca01f0d`, frozen base `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. The preserved external review is `20261108T071144Z-worker08-independent-worker05-full188-payload138`, YAML SHA256 `bdde7d4101546e0e43f0752e4587c4d0c3a0fb43f887d82eee2d869edd5c06b0`. All 188 case-decision hashes and all 138 selected payload hashes were independently rebound to the published core; the sealed scientific review remains needs_curation. This comment records bounded follow-up before author correction, not approval or application.

Exact W05-CR-F08 extension to #1230. These four concentration-qualified owner families require original stock-versus-dose scope. Concentration text alone does not establish a solvent, complete stock or wrong identity. Preserve all literal/history provenance and supported current source deltas; unresolved preparation remains withheld.

Native eligibility is a pinned function probe, not a new consumer-index rebuild or scientific support. Exact payload/preimage and source pointers are retained in W05 findings.json and the coordinator scope-and-policy-verification.json.  Preserve all original captures, history, known source/form/role and supported-versus-withheld holds. Use existing guarded proposal validation and independent review; no new code, test, schema, threshold, owner-selection rule, merge, corpus publication or approval transfer is authorized by this finding.

Reviewed W02 head `0597d00417be4d7cdfb5a31970043eec9bbc88fe`, frozen campaign base `e000d66dd26ab053e9b17ce7bf8d3c873c3dde99`. Authoritative peer review is `assembly-v2/review.yaml` (SHA256 `31cac38cae0cfb3dcfae4453a01402dc98d249f70ad9a7698a89b25eed5eae11`) in the sealed W04 independent W02 packet, whose 2,399-member SHA256SUMS is `99306617655b1e3df84368079e49f4341a0fd05667bdf9fedf18dda24f4f7ca7`. The coordinator verified all manifest members, rebound all188 case decisions and106 selected payloads, and independently repeated all106 native guarded writes and baseline/overlay partonomy. Structural validation passes; the scientific verdict remains needs_curation. These are unapplied proposal corrections, not changes already made to main or whole-owner/export approval.

W02-F-INHERITED-ALIASES / w02-external-b-010 adds two concentration-label contexts. `Nh42ni_So42_X_6_H2o.yaml` retains `(NH4)2Ni(SO4)2 x6H2O (0.1%w/v)` as HYDRATE_FORM; its bare double-salt sibling also retains the stock text. Keep the supported nickel-stock preparation separate from neat solute and preserve1050's unresolved generic-owner form/merge decision. Do not repair by choosing a namespace or merging the two owners.

`P-aminobenzoic_Acid.yaml` retains `pABA (0.3 µg/µL)` as an identity-bearing label. Its original stock-versus-dose context is not established: do not call it a proven stock or manufacture a preparation merely because a concentration is printed. Recover and assess source scope, retaining literal/history and withholding unsupported global alias approval. The independently confirmed ABEE ethyl-ester conflict is separate and has its own proposed tracker.
